items.text: Yerusalem nyo melö ghanate
Kïlenchanïn ECHOTYON ngat,
“Wero chi, porchinö Yerusalem tïkwïn cho ghach cho kikwigh.
Aimwochï Yerusalem lö mwoghöy Echotyon TORORÖT lö,
“Kikïyichini koro Kanan. Pö papongu pipö Amori, kï pö yongu pipö Ititi.
Möminye chi nyo kimut sïrumpengu otini kikïyiyinyi anta mwatinyi tïlilitunö anta chïkeninyi partin anta yenïn.
Möminye chi nyo kisyonchinyi kwighunyi tïkuchoni amöminye chi nyo kichaminyi wölo kikïwirchinyi sany, ompöwölo kikïmötinyi asisini kikïyiyinyi.
“ ‘Otini kyaweran ato lekïto nyi, asïwinyi tyorsïye ompö kisönköku. Olenchinyi isöp lasiny
aipit le ket nyo tïnkus nyo mamïnïng ailïkwï mïrar. Kïrïtunyi kitïn akïpit puteku, ompöwölo kichinyi chïrut.
“ ‘Otini kyaweratinyi ngat, asïwan lö kömïchï kepinyi. Oyenan chïrutyengu kotinyan, ayomisön opinyi. Aman muma* nyo pö kensyö nko nyi, ilïkunyi nyinyan.
“ ‘Achengan pögh amwatinyi, awuntö kisönköku atolapay ayileninyi mwagh.
Kyolokunyi sïro cho pïchigh nko kwegh cho pö menyon nko sïra katani nyo pïchigh nyo kiyeno kegh.
Olokunyi karïn cho pïchighöch, cho pö ewun nko sïrïmnyon nyo pö kat.
Akoninyi kaymorïs nyo pö sör nko taghoy cho pö yitïn nko tenta nyo pïchigh.

Kitïngönyi kari koltin nko silpa ailokenyi osis sïro pö katani cho kikïsïl nko karïn. Kyomenyi makatin cho kikigha pïsya nko kumat nko mwaghpa orolwö. Pïchighitunyi nyoman ntökïrich lïkunanyi koko pöytoghin.
Kirumtenyi ompö punton akwompö pïchighyengu, ompöwölo ani nyo kyaghinyi pïchighituna.
“ ‘Wölo kikwolenyi kegh pïchighyengu nko kinkïtötengu ailïkunyi cheporesyan.
Kipöghisyeghenyi sïroköku walaka aimina wölo isoghonyi körkeyïntin, aighanyi le chepores nyo töni kegh chi anka tïkwïl, kïgh nyo kitomönye kwigha amökwighonye.
Kichenganyi karichan pö koltin nko silpa chay kyokoninyi, aighanyi körkeyïntin cho le mïrön aigh cheporesnan tïkwïl.
Kichenganyi sïro chini pïchighöch kyokononinyi, aiyenö körkeyïntinechini, airopchinyi körkeyïntinechoni mwadanyan nko tïkuchay ngutoy cho onyïn kyokoninyi.
Kyokoninyi omisyö, pïsya nko mwaghpa arol nko kumat, wölo kitötenyi le amöros tökïnguchï nyo anyïn körkeyïntinechini.
“ ‘Atolapay ichenganyi moneku cho le wor nko tipïn cho kiyiywaninyi, aropchï körkeyïntin le amöros. Ki kïgh nyo mïnïng cheporesnan nyo kighanyi so,
tökïlïku nyï ketïghönyi monechan airopchï chane körkeyïntin le amöros?
Kewutyeghenyi so kegh? Menananyinye atanya kichinyi mïnïng, ato kichinyi chïrut nyo kilenyi walaka nko kisön?’ ”
Otöpö cheporesnana Yerusalem
Lentöy Echotyon TORORÖT, “Heywey! Heywey akwa chï kagh ghokï cho ghach le chï!
Kopechikwa atek korïn kurerang ortïn cho kïsogho körkeyïntin, agha cheporesnan ompö wolö töror.

Kyatekakwa wölo otöteghokwa amörostin tororötino putintön ompö sörömu ortïn aiwira terityon pïchighyengu otinini kepöghisyeghenyi ighena cheporesnan nko chi anka tïkwïl nyo kengwïnchinyi, ntökwanyi katasa tya cheporesnanengu.
Kyachamakwa ape pöröy nko pipö Misri, pörörisköku cho kiloyö nko pïrchin, aghakwa cheporesnan tïkwïl ntökwanyï kyanyalan.
“Ye nyu, okonokwa sitöt, achengenekwa kisoyönutköchan atolapay otonokwa mori melö relonekwa kong, ompö Pilisti cho otöptönkwa nyo pö cheporesnan.
“Kighanyi cheporesnan nko pipö Asirya tïkwïl, ompöwölo melö kimïchinyi chinö walaka kichinyi cheporesyantengwa.
Kighenyi cheporesnan nko mïnchïris pö Papilonia, wölo melö kimïchinyi ompö choni tïkwïl.”
Kilö Echotyon TORORÖT, “Kïchï nyi nyï kegh cheporesnan nyo metïng ompö arasï.
Ketekanyi korin kurerang ortïn cho kïsogho körkeyïntin, aigha cheporesnan. Wölo melö kilatenyi cheporestin walaka, ompöwölo kitaghanyi ropïyen.
Ilatenyi korka nyo le chepores nyo chomöy pich walaka kïtïl pontenyi.
Töni mïrön ropïyen cheporestin, wölo ketönönyi ropöw nyo le nyi pich cho ichömenyi, ompöwölo imökenyi chane kïpkana wop anka tïkwïl kïpkonchinyi.
Ichinyi chepores nyo sis, möminye chi nyo kechikyinyi igha, ketönönyi pich ropïyen, möminye chi nyo koninyi! Kïlenyona ichinyi sis nyoman.”
Kirwoko Tororöt ompö Yerusalem
Tera ye nyu chepkartayantanï ngölyonto ECHOTYON.
Lentöy Echotyon TORORÖT, “Kengwïsanyi sïroköku le chepores, aitönönyi kegh chamaneku nko körkeyïntineku, aitïghönyi moneku, aitö körkeyïntin le amöros.
Oghömïtunan chitoniku cho pö köny löwïr cho kichömenyi nko cho kitöghenyi. Oghan chane kuwitinyi, angwïsan sïroköku atökïsïwa chane chïrutyengu.
Orwokyininyi akwompö cheporesnanengu nyo kitïlanyi kasar nko kisön cho kimïltenyi, okoninyi sitöt ompö nörekyenyan nko sastaghnatenyan.
Otöninyi morikwa akurultoy chane wölay kighonyi cheporesnan, aisagha körkeyïntin. Chengöy chane sïroköku nko kariku cho karamach akïpïstinyi kïchïrut.
“Ipunyi pich cho möngörï kïwireninyi koghïn akïtörotöreninyi chokonikwa.
Akïpel koriku akurwokyinyi ompö tawu kor cho möngörï. Oghinyi nyu pïstenö cheporesnan amökïminye ropïyen cho tetönenyi chamanköku.
Wonyot nyu nörekyenyan ompö nyi, akuwonyö sastaghnatenyan ompö nyi, akalyanan amelö tonörekan.
Kïle wölo kewutyeghenyi wölo kyanamtinyi atanya kichinyi mïnïng, aighaninyi anarekan ompö tïkwïn cho keghanyi. Kilenyona oghokeninyi ngalechi löwïr kighonyi?”
Le wölo lata kame kïlata cheptö
Kïlö ECHOTYON, “Pöghisyegho pich mwaghatanï ompö nyi Yerusalem, ‘Le wölo lata kame, kïlata cheptö.’
Ilatenyi chepto yongu, nyo reyöy pontenyi nko monechi. Ichinyi chepto ompö tipikwa cho kirey poyikwa nko monekwa. Yongu kï pö pipö Ititi, papongu kï pö pipö Amori.
“Cheptönkwa nyo wow Samaria nyo mi okumpö löt nko tipichi, cheptönkwa nyo mïnïng kï Sodoma nyo mi okumpö tagh nko tipichi.
Melö kirïpanyi ortïnekwa anta igh ghöyityengwa, wölo kiwaghakenyi ompö ato mïnïng, ainyara kïtïl chane ompö ortïneku.
“Lentöy Echotyon TORORÖT, kïle ato osöpan, meghnye cheptönkwa Sodoma nko tipichi ghöyityö nyo lenye nyï keghanyi nko tipiku.
Ghöyityö nyo kigh Sodoma, kï kikwol kegh nyinte nko tipichi, ompöwölo kitïng omisyö nyo kyomöy, akï möngöy ompö kalya, wölo melö kiyang pich cho le chopot.
Kikwol kegh chane akwigh tïkwïn cho ghach, kïlenyona anyaran chane lenyini kyasïwekwa.
“Meghnye Samaria ompö nïsu ngokï cho keghanyi, keghanyi ngokï cho ghach tya kïtïl chane. Aighanyi chane kïpöyit man ompö tïkwïn cho ghach löwïr cho keghanyi.
Ipö nyu arasingu onkït, köghachitu ngokiku nyoman kïtïl cho pö tipikwa, nyo kegh chane kïpöyit man. Nya kïnaminyi arasï onkït, aisït nïkisyengu onkït, ompöwölo keghanyi tipikwa kïpöyit man.”
Kiyokunogh pö Sodoma nko Samaria
Kïlenchï ECHOTYON Yerusalem, “Otyokan naman pö Sodoma nko tipikwa nko naman pö Samaria nko tipikwa, atyakan namanköku cho mi kwenungwa.
Tepönyi arasï akïnaminyi arasï ompö tïkwïn löwïr cho kighanyi tökïsaghsagh tipikwa chane.
Kiyokyini nyu tipikwa Sodoma nko Samaria nko monekwa ngat ororyengwa le nyo pö tagh, akeyokyininyi tïkwïl nko tipiku.
Melö kisasanyi so cheptönkwa Sodoma atanya kikwolönyi kegh,
kïtomö kïrumtö ghöyityengu? Kekaranyi kegh nko nyinte ye nyu, köroröchinyi ye nyu pipö Edom nko pöröroskachi nko tipö Pilisti cho sösinyi ompö wop tïkwïl.
Kenyorunyi kïrïp kegh nko cheporesnanengu nko ghöyityengu.”
Muma nyo töpo kokay
Lentöy Echotyon TORORÖT, “Owunyi lenyini keghanyi, ompöwölo kesasanyi kiyomisutköku ainyaranyi muma.
Wölo oripan mumenyan nko nyi nyo pö atanya kichinyi monïng, aghan muma nko nyi nyo pö kokay.
Inonenyi ngal cho kighanyi, aisïkenyi arasï otini kamïla cheptönkwa nyay mïnïng nko nyay wow. Oghan chane le tipiku, wölo melö kyaman muma lenyoni nko nyi.
Oman ngat mumenyan nko nyi atenkïtunönyi lö ochan ECHOTYON.
Olöstewunyi lelutköku löwïr cho kighanyi, wölo otini kenananyi, nöminyi kïgh kut ompö arasï.”
